If so, could you mark your implementation with `@RegisterForReflection` and see if it fixes your issue?

OK, looks like a bug then. Thanks for reporting.
@gsmet FWIW, here is my code:  https://github.com/matzew/quarfka-source

I will have a look. Thanks! 

@mkouba did you already see such kind of issue?

So the problem is that there is no `ReactiveStreamsFactory` service provider registered. This SPI is implemented in `smallrye-reactive-streams-operators`. It works in JDK mode because `smallrye-reactive-streams-operators` is a transitive dependency of `quarkus-smallrye-reactive-messaging-kafka`. However, in order to make it work on substrate we need to register a `ServiceProviderBuildItem` ->  implemented in `io.quarkus:quarkus-smallrye-reactive-streams-operators`.

WORKAROUND: add the `io.quarkus:quarkus-smallrye-reactive-streams-operators` dependency to the application pom.xml. @matzew could you verify this pls?

PROPOSED FIX: add the `io.quarkus:quarkus-smallrye-reactive-streams-operators` dependency to the `quarkus-smallrye-reactive-messaging` deployment module pom.xml. @cescoffier does it sound reasonable?

issue.title: Add a dependency on the Reactive Streams Operators implementation in Reactive Messaging
issue.body:
Fix #1495.

As proposed in the issue, add a dependency on the Quarkus SmallRye Reactive Streams Operators module in the SmallRye Reactive Messaging module to the user do not have to declare it explicitly.
